neighbours.label: mutual dependence or coordination between two or more parts (coordinated, coupled, interdependent, interact, dependencies between) versus the same parts acted on separately
fire: The traffic lights along the avenue are synchronized so cars hit green after green.
In this ecosystem the fate of the bees and the orchids is closely intertwined.
The two pumps work in tandem, each adjusting to the pressure of the other.
Climate and ocean currents are tightly coupled through heat exchange.
The hospital and the ambulance service must coordinate their schedules every night.
Prices in the two markets are strongly correlated with each other.
These modules are mutually dependent, so changing one breaks the other.
The gears mesh together and drive each other at fixed ratios.
quiet: The traffic lights along the avenue were repainted green last spring.
In this ecosystem the bees nest in hollow trees near the river.
The two pumps were delivered on a truck from the factory.
Climate in the north is cold and dry for most of the year.
The hospital and the ambulance station are painted white.
Prices in the two markets are listed on a board each morning.
These modules are written in Python and stored in one folder.
The gears are made of brass and kept in a wooden box.
